_doc: Brand trademark dictionary. When a slide title contains a known product or technology term, a ™ or ® node is appended as a separate superscript text node to the right of the title. Rendering spec: Suisse Int'l Regular, 25% of the title's font size, top-aligned (tm.y = title bounding-box top). Terms are matched by substring (e.g. 'Kitchen Station' covers 'Kitchen Station 1', 'Kitchen Station 2', etc.). Extend terms[] when a new trademarked product ships.

titleSuperscriptSpec._note: tm.x = titleBB.right + gapPx; tm.y = titleBB.top (slide-relative). At 25% of title size the ™ sits naturally in the cap-height zone, reading as a superscript without Figma's built-in superscript offset.
